- Define an ordered list of valid planets from Mercury to Neptune; create a mapping from name to index for quick lookup. Validate both inputs exist in the mapping; if not, return an empty tuple.
- Get indices i and j for planet1 and planet2. Determine the slice strictly between them: if i < j, slice (i+1:j); if i > j, slice (j+1:i); if equal, return empty tuple.
- Return the sliced sublist as a tuple (already in solar-distance order).
